  "cypher": "MATCH (bh:Player {name: "Buddy Hield"})-[:receivesAward]->(a:Award)
WITH collect(a) AS buddyAwards
MATCH (p:Player)-[:receivesAward]->(a)
WHERE a IN buddyAwards AND p <> bh
RETURN p.name AS playerName, count(DISTINCT a) AS awardCount
ORDER BY awardCount DESC"

{
  "cypher": "MATCH (p:Player)-[:playsPosition]->(pos:Position)
WHERE pos.name CONTAINS "power forward" OR ANY(a IN pos.aliases WHERE a CONTAINS "power forward")
MATCH (p)-[:playsPosition]->(otherPos:Position)
WHERE otherPos <> pos
RETURN otherPos.name AS positionName, count(DISTINCT p) AS playerCount
ORDER BY playerCount DESC"
  ,
  "rationale": "The query finds players who play a position whose name or alias contains "power forward", then lists every other position they play and counts distinct players per position."
}
